plugins.name: Network
plugins.description: Network logs and mock response tools via in-app interceptor.
plugins.releaseNotes: Redesigned hosts column and call inspector, a network waterfall, a cURL dialog that can replay a call, and a compact mock editor. Mock groups can be kept in Git, and a scenario can pick single rules. Works with Dev Scenario 0.9.23 and later.

plugins.name: Accessibility
plugins.description: WCAG 2.1 compliance scanner with visual overlay and score reporting.
plugins.releaseNotes: Matches the new Dev Scenario look and its new fonts. Clear history asks in the app's own Yes / No dialog. Works with Dev Scenario 0.9.23 and later.

plugins.name: Artifactory
plugins.description: Install app builds from Nexus on a device, then run a suite on them.
plugins.releaseNotes: A device .ipa now installs on an iOS simulator on Macs with Apple silicon, converted on the way (not App Store / TestFlight downloads). The converted copy turns on Dev Scenario's in-app SDK and network interceptor when the build includes them.

plugins.name: MCP
plugins.description: Let AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, …) inspect devices and write, run and triage E2E flows over MCP.
plugins.releaseNotes: Agents save scenarios into folders, tag them for their suites, and manage suites, tags and run presets when asked. The assistant on Copilot uses your account's own models, with effort per model. Other plugins can hand the assistant a prompt to send (Migration's Migrate). Works with Dev Scenario 0.9.16 and later.
